sentences.en: Hundreds of people called or wrote to the Gorilla Foundation.
sentences.zh: 数百人给大猩猩基金会打电话或写信。

sentences.en: Modern civilization rests on a foundation of science and education.
sentences.zh: 现代文明建立在科学和教育的基础上。

sentences.en: Who would better his state should look to his foundations.
sentences.zh: 改善国家的人应该从基础做起。

senses.zh: 建立, 设立, 创办 - 基础, 基本原理, 根据 - 地基 - 基金(会) 形容词: foundational
